title: Minit game meta.json
description: Schema for the meta.json shipped at the root of a Minit game ZIP, next to index.html. Mirrors the Creator Console's parser (MetaJsonSchema / DropConfigSchema / licensePolicy in minit-root's @minit/shared).

title.description: Display title. Convention: <Game name> <two thematically matching emojis>.

controls.description: How the player controls the game. Markdown, 2-4 bullets.

logic.description: Core rules and loop. Markdown, 2-4 bullets.

description.description: Free-form Markdown body describing the game.

schemaVersion.description: Forward-compat hook. Nothing branches on it today; unknown values stay valid.

resultSorting.description: How this game's result list is ordered.

config.description: Tunable values the game exposes to creators. At least one entry is required before Superposting can be enabled.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the bundle's content, or "proprietary" for the creator's own content. Absent and "proprietary" are deliberately distinct: absent means nothing was declared and is never gated, while "proprietary" is an affirmative ownership claim. The Console matches the identifier EXACTLY against the recognized list enumerated in this schema, and gates only on those: of the recognized identifiers, the NC variants and GPL-2.0/GPL-3.0/AGPL-3.0 (both the deprecated bare spelling and the current -only/-or-later spelling) cannot be hosted, and MIT, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Zlib, ISC, Apache-2.0 and the CC-BY variants expect a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt file next to index.html in the ZIP. Any string outside that list — including a variant the list does not carry, such as Apache-2.0-with-LLVM-exception — is accepted and left ungated, exactly like an absent license.

credits.description: Freeform player-facing credit line for third-party assets. Does NOT replace THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt — a notice-requiring license needs both.

sourceUrl.description: URL pointing at the original asset/library source. Must start with http:// or https://.

anyOf.title: Hostable — modding restricted
anyOf.description: CC-BY-SA-4.0 is flagged for review and its derivatives inherit ShareAlike; CC-BY-ND-4.0 forces modding off.

anyOf.title: Not hostable — the upload will be rejected
anyOf.description: NonCommercial variants conflict with ads and the creator fund; GPL/AGPL are rejected pending counsel (app-store distribution and network-use source disclosure).

anyOf.title: Any other identifier
anyOf.description: Any string outside the recognized list above, including a variant the list does not carry (Apache-2.0-with-LLVM-exception, a typo). Accepted by the parser and never gated, exactly like an absent license.

key.description: Unique within config, compared after trimming surrounding whitespace. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character, since an all-whitespace key trims to empty.

description.description: Human-readable label, max 100 characters. A longer one is dropped silently; the entry is still accepted.

value.description: The default value. The string form of a number or boolean is accepted and normalized ("10" -> 10, "true" -> true).

defaultValue.description: Alias for value. If both are present, value wins.

range.description: Fixed list of allowed values. Mutually exclusive with min/max and minLength/maxLength; value must be one of the members.

min.description: Lower bound. Only valid when valueType is number.

max.description: Upper bound. Only valid when valueType is number.

minLength.description: Minimum length. Only valid when valueType is string.

maxLength.description: Maximum length. Only valid when valueType is string.

moddable.description: true = other creators may change this value in their mods, false = locked, absent = unmarked (treated as open).
